dimensions.reason: Curtin prohibits uploading lecture slides or audio transcripts to GenAI tools (N133) with a secure-tool disability exception (N231), requires AI transparency and privacy compliance (N001), and defines consent for University data collection (N016/N017), but a student's undisclosed live audio/video capture of identifiable lecture participants is not explicitly bounded.

documents_checked.text:
Students are not permitted to upload work to GenAI tools that does not belong to them. This
includes, lecture slides, transcription of audio, assessment questions and tutorial questions in which
Curtin owns the copyright.

documents_checked.document_title: Copyright and GenAI teaching accessibility and protected material
documents_checked.text:
Anyone who has a disability can use copyrighted material with Gen-AI or AI powered tools for
accessibility purposes to support personal study and learning. This includes using
Curtin-owned teaching and learning material (such as lecture slides, lecture recordings,
captions or transcripts). Curtin staff can also use this provision to assist students who have
accessibility needs. Ensure that:
Gen-AI tools used are secure (e.g. they do not train on or share content)
Outputs are not shared publicly (e.g. posted on the open internet)

Principle 6: Transparency, Explainability and Contestability
Develop, deploy and use AI systems in a way that maximises transparency,
explainability and contestability. Allow stakeholders to know when AI has
been used and contest decisions made using AI.

case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: An operational permission/consent boundary for undisclosed capture or processing of identifiable lecture participants.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: N016 and N017 bind University collection and disclosure rather than student-operated live-lecture recording assistants, and N133 is an unverified webpage addressing copyright upload of slides/transcripts rather than establishing an operational permission/consent boundary for undisclosed capture of identifiable lecture participants.
case_summary.case_note: Curtin requires AI transparency and privacy compliance (N001), restricts uploading lecture slides or audio transcripts to GenAI tools except for disability accessibility (N133, N231), and regulates University data collection via consent (N016, N017). However, no operative policy establishes an operational permission or consent boundary for a student's undisclosed AI capture of identifiable lecture participants (D5=2, Critical gap=Yes). Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15.
